title: Zephyr: /presence/cache with age_s tracking
description: Presence cache with age in seconds
close_reason: Invalid: This is a new feature implementation task, not a bug to fix. The /presence/cache CoAP resource does not exist in Zephyr yet - it requires designing and implementing new code (types, CBOR encoding, CoAP handlers, callbacks, Kconfig) following the pattern of coap_status.c. Should be implemented as part of the Presence Cache epic once the Python reference implementation (sibling bead .2.1) is complete to provide an oracle.
